title: New work

name.label: Name
name.placeholder: The working title — you can rename any time

domain.label: What is this?
domain.hint: Fiction or non-fiction — this shapes what the analysis looks for. You can change it later in Project info.

structure.label: Structure
structure.hint: Picks the world categories (characters, items, suspects…) — change later in Project Structure (⌘,).

language.label: Language
language.hint: The work’s language steers every analysis pass and AI edit — summaries, thread titles, and findings are written in it. Set it now; a wrong first run costs a re-run.

starterHint: Starts from the guided starter content — delete its sample pages whenever you like.

ready.title: “{{name}}” is ready
ready.body: Write in the editor; the analysis rails light up after your first Update analysis run (status bar). This tour replays any time from Help.

demos.title: See it alive first
demos.body: Open “Office Drama (demo)” or “Hamlet (demo)” from the library — pre-analyzed, every rail already lit.
